doc_name: List of Mr. Box Office episodes
text: Mr. Box Office is an American syndicated sitcom that first aired on September 22, 2012. The show focuses on Marcus Jackson (played by Bill Bellamy), a prominent movie actor who finds himself in legal trouble after a physical confrontation with a paparazzo, resulting in a sentence to teach a class of inner-city high school students in Los Angeles' well-known South Central neighborhood. The following is a list of episodes presented in the order of their original broadcast airdate.
